children: Tempest Therapeutics entered an exclusive collaboration, option and license agreement to access Heibei Senlang Biotechnology’s in vivo CAR-T technology. The four-month option, exercisable for about $447,000, would grant Tempest an exclusive, sublicensable license worldwide excluding Greater China. If exercised, Tempest would owe annual maintenance fees starting at $10 million and rising to $14 million over three years, a 6% royalty on net sales, and a share of any sublicense revenue, alongside development obligations and milestones. Both parties received a right of first negotiation for Greater China, and the agreement includes customary termination rights, including Tempest’s ability to terminate for convenience on 90 days’ notice.
